name: Counselors
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of godly counselors in guiding and securing the well-being of God's people. Proverbs teaches that without counsel, individuals and communities fall, but with many counselors, there is safety and established purpose, highlighting the wisdom found in heeding godly advice. Ezekiel reveals God's own care in seeking the lost and strengthening the weak, illustrating the shepherd-like role of spiritual guidance. Furthermore, Amos reminds us that God reveals His plans through His servants, the prophets, underscoring the divine origin of true counsel, while Ephesians calls believers to live worthy of their calling, which includes embracing wise counsel in their walk with the Lord.
